fn encode_cyclic(s: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(s) >= 0)
  ensures (len(s) == len(result))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(s) - (len(s) % 3)): ((not ((i % 3) == 0)) or (result[i] == s[(i + 1)]))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(s) - (len(s) % 3)): ((not ((i % 3) == 1)) or (result[i] == s[(i + 1)]))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(s) - (len(s) % 3)): ((not ((i % 3) == 2)) or (result[i] == s[(i - 2)]))
  ensures forall i in (len(s) - (len(s) % 3))..len(s): (result[i] == s[i])
  effects pure
  example (encode_cyclic([]) == [])
{
  []
}
